title: TAKE UP THE ARK AND GO AHEAD

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Joshua said to the priests, "Take up the ark of the covenant and pass on ahead of the people." So they took it up and went ahead of them. — Josh 3:6 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Now the priests are told to lift the ark and go first — right to the front, ahead of everyone else, straight toward a flooded river. Imagine being one of those priests. You are carrying the sacred ark on your shoulders, and you are told to lead the whole nation into a river at flood stage, with no bridge and no plan except "God will make a way."

This is leadership by faith. The priests had to step out before they could see how it would work. As we will discover, the river did not part until their feet actually touched the water. God asked them to move first and trust that He would act.

That is often how God works with us. He rarely shows us the whole path before we take the first step. He asks us to move in obedience, and then He makes the way. Faith walks toward the water believing God will do what only He can do.

Notice too that God's presence went ahead of the people. He did not send them into the unknown alone; He led the way. This points us to Christ, our great forerunner who has gone ahead of us into every hard place, even through death itself, opening the way for us to follow (Heb 6:20). Wherever God calls us to go, He has already gone before.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Is God asking you to step out in faith before you can see how things will work?
2. What "river" stands before you that only God can part?
3. How does it strengthen you that Christ has gone ahead of you?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, give me the courage of those priests, to step forward before I see the way. Thank You that You always go ahead of me. Amen.
